title: Submit an Inquiry
description: Fill out the inquiry form or contact our admissions office to express interest and receive the prospectus.

title: Tour & Assessment
description: Attend an open house or private tour, followed by an age-appropriate entrance assessment.

title: Application & Documents
description: Submit the completed application form along with academic records and required documents.

title: Offer & Enrollment
description: Successful applicants receive an offer letter; enrolment is confirmed once the acceptance form is returned.
